name: Questioning Your Faith
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of doubt and questioning within the life of faith, as seen in the heartfelt laments of the psalmist who asks why his soul is cast down and disquieted, yet encourages hope in God’s presence (Psalms 42:5). The prophet Habakkuk boldly questions God's apparent silence amid violence (Habakkuk 1:2), and even John the Baptist, from prison, sought assurance about Christ's works (Matthew 11:2). Jesus himself addressed doubt directly, gently rebuking those with little faith and acknowledging that some who encountered Him still doubted (Matthew 14:31; 28:17). These passages reveal that questioning can coexist with worship and trust, pointing believers to rely on God’s faithfulness even amid uncertainty.
